vanderbilt-msf.tuitionLabel: Owen MS Finance tuition (2026–27 AY; 9-month program)
vanderbilt-msf.feesNote: Mandatory direct fees from Owen MSF tuition page / Student Accounts: Transcript $100 + Maintenance (MSF) $1,250 + Student Health Fee $882 + Student Services Fee $694 = $2,926. Health insurance $4,244 (waivable with comparable coverage) separate. Loan fees on COA page are financing estimates, not billed fees.
vanderbilt-msf.notes: 9-month full-time MSF. Tuition subject to change annually. Financial Aid COA also lists Owen MBA/MSF/MAcc/MMark First Year direct costs total $79,626 (tuition $76,700 + fees). All applicants auto-considered for partial merit scholarships; no need-based scholarships.

livingCostBand.basis: Owen MSF page Average Living Expenses sum Housing $16,030 + Food $7,488 + Personal $2,013 + Transportation $1,526 = $27,057. VU Financial Aid graduate COA First Year Indirect Total $32,270 (includes books $500 + housing $16,128 + food $7,714 + personal & health insurance $6,186 + transportation $1,526 + loan fees $216).

rochester-msf.tuitionLabel: Full-Time MS in Finance tuition per year (2026–27 AY)
rochester-msf.feesNote: Activity Fee $800/year + Mandatory Health Fee $1,027/year (health fees are estimates pending NY State approval in June). Health Insurance $3,906/year separate. Intl: ISO Fee $140/year + International Student Programming Fee $900 one-time. Optional Internship Track fee $5,500.
rochester-msf.period: 2026–27 (rates accurate as of 2025-11-14 per Simon page)
rochester-msf.notes: STEM. Tracks: 9-month non-internship vs 16-month internship (+$5,500 fee). Tuition published as $/year — 9-mo track typically one billed year; 16-mo may extend across a second academic year (second-year tuition not separately itemized on page — missing ≠ 0 for multi-year total). Fall entry for MS Finance per admissions FAQs (curriculum page spring banner appears shared/MS-wide — treat Fall as SoT for Finance).

livingCostBand.basis: Simon published 2026–27 MSF living: Housing $10,206 + Food $6,273 + Travel $2,250 + Personal $2,466 + Books $1,310 = $22,505/year (excludes health insurance).

sources: Simon Full-Time MS Tuition & Financial Aid

florida-msf.tuitionEstimateLabel: Estimate only: 32 graduate credits × $1,449.28 non-resident graduate rate (2026–27) = $46,376.96 — NOT a published MSF program sticker
florida-msf.feesNote: Per-credit graduate rates already include listed mandatory fee components (CITF, financial aid, technology, A&S, athletic, health, transportation). No separate MSF program fee schedule published.
florida-msf.period: 2026–27 per-credit schedule (program has no flat sticker)
florida-msf.notes: CRITICAL ACCESS FLAG: William R. Hough MS in Finance is a combination/accelerated pathway — applications are only sought from current University of Florida undergraduates (apply in second year; min ~3.6 GPA). Not an open external Fall 2027 MSF for HK/TW/PRC applicants. 32 credits; 16 graduate credits may be taken before bachelor's finish; 12 credits double-count. Florida resident graduate rate $532.52/credit → 32× = $17,040.64. Combination + Bright Futures/Prepaid may further reduce cost for eligible FL students only. Missing program sticker ≠ 0.
florida-msf.startTerm: Combination with UF UG timeline (not a standard open Fall MSF start)
florida-msf.accessNote: Current UF undergraduates only per program admissions page.

asu-msf.tuitionLabel: MS-FIN Corporate finance track — estimated total tuition and fees, International
asu-msf.tuitionAltLabel: MS-FIN Analytical methods track — estimated total tuition and fees, International
asu-msf.feesNote: One-time non-refundable enrollment deposit $500 required before registration (in addition to estimated totals as published). Estimated totals are labeled tuition and fees combined.
asu-msf.period: as published on W. P. Carey MS-FIN cost page (Fall 2027 cycle; subject to ABOR change)
asu-msf.notes: STEM. Starts August; length 9–16 months (Corporate vs Analytical methods). Resident / Nonresident / International estimates: Corporate $43,500 / $70,000 / $73,500; Analytical $61,500 / $95,000 / $99,500. Same figures on main program page as of asOf.
sources: W. P. Carey MS-FIN Cost & Financial Aid

uci-msf.tuitionLabel: Master of Finance program fee total — cohort entering Fall 2026 (4 quarters × $20,212)
uci-msf.feesNote: Mandatory campus fees on Fall 2026 cohort schedule (excl. optional UCGPC ~$7): Student Services Access $1,096 + Assoc. Grad Students $56 + Student Center $617.27 + Bren Events $92 + Recreation $352 + Student Health Insurance $7,771.86 ≈ $9,985.13. Total fees paid on schedule $90,833.13 including program fee.

uci-msf.notes: STEM. 12-month / 4-quarter full-time MFin (52 units). Merage financial-aid page points to Registrar fee assessment; living budget published for nine months (F/W/S) only — summer living not in that table.

villanova-msf.tuitionLabel: Entire MSF program tuition 2026–27 ($1,900 per credit)
villanova-msf.feesNote: University general fee $157 each semester. Two semesters ≈ $314; exact semester count depends on July–start calendar (confirm billable terms). Mandatory health insurance listed for I-20 proof $2,360 (intl).
villanova-msf.notes: STEM. Full-time ~11 months; starts in person in July (summer start). Intl I-20 funding proof: tuition $57,000 + living $15,000 + health insurance $2,360 = $74,360 (+ $157/sem general fee).

livingCostBand.basis: Villanova MSF international students page: Living Expenses $15,000 required for funding proof (plus health insurance $2,360).

notredame-msf.tuitionLabel: MSF tuition for 2026–2027 academic year (Summer + Fall/Spring)
notredame-msf.feesNote: Financial Aid COA: Summer fees $400 + Fall/Spring fees $2,200 (= program fee $1,600 + student fees $600 on Mendoza breakdown) = $2,600. Mendoza page also lists Program Fee $1,600 (Fall/Spring) and Student Fees $400 summer / $600 Fall/Spring.
notredame-msf.notes: STEM. Start Date June (summer). 38 credit hours. Tuition split on COA: Summer $21,604 + Fall/Spring $53,014 = $74,618. Total program COA published $111,298 including living.

livingCostBand.basis: ND Financial Aid MSF COA housing and food: Summer $3,465 + Fall/Spring $17,820 = $21,285. Books/supplies $400+$1,750; personal $700+$6,720; transportation $525+$2,700 also published.

utd-msf.tuitionLabel: MS Finance Cohort out-of-state / non-Texas total tuition and fees for the degree
utd-msf.feesNote: Published $50,000 (OOS) / $35,000 (TX resident) are total tuition and fees for the degree (includes program activities, internship/capstone, communication training, career coaching, business school per-credit fee). Living and health insurance extra. Paid in two installments (fall and spring).
utd-msf.period: as published on MS Finance Cohort page (Fall 2027 cycle; subject to change)
utd-msf.notes: CFA-aligned cohort; ~12-month, 36 semester credit hours. Summer start of sequence (Semester 1 summer courses). High-achieving admits auto-considered for scholarship levels applied to tuition; awards do NOT create in-state tuition status. Cohort students excluded from general JSOM graduate scholarship portal — contact program director.
utd-msf.startTerm: Summer start of cohort sequence (then Fall/Spring/Summer)
